answer: New identities earn into a locked vault, not a wallet: rewards vest only after ten clean epochs, and any peer can challenge a vault with evidence of copied work, draining it if the challenge holds. An honest agent simply waits out the voyage from newcomer to trusted member. A Sybil farmer faces a spiral of locked vaults, each needing ten epochs of clean work before a coin vests, while one caught clone drains its whole line. Like a wharf charging rent per berth, the delay costs ten epochs of capital per fake, so mass fakery pays nothing until long after honest agents have been paid.
